description.text: China Agricultural University now offers 144 Master and 95 Doctoral programs to international students. Master’s programs are completed in 2 or 3 years, and Doctoral programs 3 or 4 years. Certificates of degrees and graduation will be awarded to those who have completed the entire course work and passing thesis/dissertation defense. For details of specific majors offered, please refer to the lists of Masters majors and PhD majors. The university now offers English-taught programs.

duration.text: The Food Science at China Agricultural University is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 3611 USD/per year ￥ 26000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Application Form 2. A clearly scanned copy of the personal information page on the valid passport in color 3. A clearly scanned copy of the Bachelor's degree certificates 4. A scanned copy of the academic transcript for the Bachelor degree during the entire study period 5. CV 6. Study plan and personal statement 7. Proof of Chinese or English proficiency (HSK; IELTS, TOEFL, Duolinguo, SAT, GRE and other proofs of English proficiency) 8. Physical Examination Certificate issued within the last 6 months 9. Non-criminal record certificate issued within last 5 months 10. Two ‘Recommendation Letters’ from Professors or Associate Professors 11. Financial Supporter Form and Bank Deposit Statement 12. Notarized copies of other awards or academic achievements. 13. Digital signature 14. Self-introduction video in Chinese or English

requirements.text: 1)Non-Chinese citizens who do not have Chinese nationality under the Nationality Law of the People's Republic of China and hold a valid ordinary passport; 2)Physically and mentally healthy, meet the physical examination requirements for Chinese Visa or Residence Permit applicants in China and the physical examination requirements of the major to study in BFSU to ensure normal study and life in China; 3)Have no violation of disciplines, no records of public security punishment or of criminal conduct; be friendly to China and behave well; comply with Chinese laws and university regulations, and respect Chinese customs and manners; 4)Applicants for Masters degrees should hold a qualification which is equivalent (or above) to a Bachelors degree from a Chinese university and be under the age of 35. Applicants for Doctoral programs degrees should hold a qualification which is equivalent (or above) to a Masters degree from a Chinese university and be under the age of 40; 5)Have a bachelor’s or masters’ degree taught in English, or TOEFL (iBT) score of 90 points at least, or IELTS score at least 6.0.
